home.heroDesc: We accompany you on your path to integral wellbeing through acupuncture and a personalized therapeutic approach.
home.essenceDesc: At the Acupuncture and Holistic Therapies Center, we are dedicated to restoring your wellbeing and vitality naturally. We believe true health is achieved when we balance body, mind, and energy, providing you with a warm and professional space designed to find the relief and peace you need in your daily life.
home.quote: True healing begins when we allow ourselves to listen to what our body and soul need to tell us.
home.servicesDesc_acupuntura: Ancient Chinese technique involving the insertion of fine needles at specific points on the body to relieve pain and treat various physical and emotional conditions.
home.servicesDesc_auriculoterapia: Treatment method that stimulates the external surface of the ear to alleviate pathological conditions in other parts of the body.
home.servicesDesc_fitoterapia: Use of plant-based products for therapeutic purposes, whether to prevent, alleviate or cure a pathological condition.
home.servicesDesc_ventosas: Ancient therapy where special cups are placed on the skin for a few minutes to create suction, facilitating blood flow and relaxation.
home.servicesDesc_tuina: Branch of Traditional Chinese Medicine that uses massage, acupressure and other forms of body manipulation.
home.servicesDesc_moxibustion: Therapy that consists of burning dried mugwort (moxa) on particular points of the body.
home.therapistQuote1: "I am Yeni Arriarán, a therapist specialized in Traditional Chinese Medicine and energy therapies. After years of high demand in the financial sector, a diagnosis of a pituitary adenoma marked a before and after in my life, pushing me to seek a more integral path of healing.
home.therapistQuote2: That is how I discovered Traditional Chinese Medicine, an approach that sees the person as a whole: body, emotions, and energy. Today, my mission is to accompany you in recovering your balance and wellbeing with a professional, conscious, and above all, human approach."

about.name: Yeni Arriarán
about.title: Founder & Therapist
about.label: Our Story
about.featuredQuote: "My journey began from a very personal place. Today my mission is to help you regain your balance."
about.para1: For many years I worked as a financial director, with a high level of demand and long hours. Over time, this rhythm began to affect my health: my body started to weaken, and I went through a period of significant imbalance.
about.para2: Receiving a diagnosis of a pituitary adenoma was a turning point: I understood that I needed to look at health differently, more holistically.
about.para3: I discovered Traditional Chinese Medicine, which opened a completely new world to me: an approach that sees the person as a whole —body, emotions, energy and habits— not just the symptom. That's where I started to feel real and lasting relief.
about.missionText: To accompany each person in a close and personalized way...
about.visionText: To create a space where health is lived with more awareness...
about.value1desc: We do not treat diseases in isolation; we listen to and accompany people.
about.value2desc: We seek the root of the problem by balancing the body, mind, and vital energy.
about.value3desc: We have created a sensory refuge designed to heal without the noise and rush of the outside world.

cookiePolicy.subtitle: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.block1text: A cookie is a file that is downloaded to your computer when you access certain web pages. Cookies allow a website, among other things, to store and retrieve information about the browsing habits of a user or their device and, depending on the information they contain and how they use their device, they can be used to recognize the user.
cookiePolicy.block2title: What types of cookies does this website use?
cookiePolicy.block2desc1: These allow the user to navigate through the website and use the different options or services that exist on it. Without them, the website may not function correctly.
cookiePolicy.block2desc2: These, processed by us or by third parties (such as Google Analytics), allow us to quantify the number of users and thus perform statistical measurement and analysis of the use made by users of the service in order to improve our offering.
cookiePolicy.block3text: When entering this website, you saw a pop-up panel (Cookie Banner) where you could accept or reject the use of optional cookies. You can modify your consent at any time by deleting the cookies from your browser and reloading the page.
cookiePolicy.block4title: How to disable cookies in browsers
cookiePolicy.block4text: You can allow, block or delete the cookies installed on your device through the settings of the browser installed on your computer. Please consult the "Help" section of your browser for more details:

services.outroTitle_ventosas: Is it painful? Does it leave marks?
services.intro_acupuntura_p1: Acupuncture is an ancient therapy of Traditional Chinese Medicine that seeks to restore the natural balance of the body, mind and emotions. It is based on stimulating specific points of the body through very fine, sterile needles placed along the energy meridians where Qi (vital energy) circulates.
services.intro_acupuntura_p2: According to TCM, when Qi flows harmoniously, the body stays healthy. However, stress, emotions, lifestyle habits or internal imbalances can block this flow, generating pain or disease.
services.intro_acupuntura_p3: From an integrative perspective, acupuncture also stimulates the nervous system, improves circulation, regulates organic functions and promotes self-regulation processes and deep wellbeing.
services.benefit_acupuntura_1_desc: Especially effective for muscle and joint pain, neck pain, lower back pain, migraines, sciatica, sports injuries and chronic pain.
services.benefit_acupuntura_2_desc: Helps reduce stress, anxiety, insomnia, mental exhaustion and emotional tension states.
services.benefit_acupuntura_3_desc: Promotes balance of the digestive, hormonal, respiratory and immune systems.
services.outro_acupuntura: In practice, acupuncture is integrated within a Chinese Medicine and holistic therapies approach, where each person is unique. The number of sessions and treatment evolution depend on the condition, constitution and individual response.
services.intro_auriculoterapia_p1: Auriculotherapy is a therapeutic technique of Traditional Chinese Medicine that uses the ear as a microsystem reflecting the entire organism. The ear represents the organs, systems and structures of the body, as well as points related to the person's emotional and energetic state.
services.intro_auriculoterapia_p2: By stimulating specific points on the ear — with seeds, spheres, very fine needles or magnets — regulatory mechanisms are activated that help the body recover its natural balance.
services.intro_auriculoterapia_p3: Auriculotherapy can be used as a main treatment or as a complement to acupuncture and other therapies, enhancing and prolonging their effects in the days following the session.
services.benefit_auriculoterapia_1_desc: Especially useful for muscle and joint pain, headaches, migraines and lower back pain.
services.benefit_auriculoterapia_2_desc: Helps balance the nervous system, reducing anxiety, nervousness and insomnia.
services.benefit_auriculoterapia_3_desc: Ideal for accompanying smoking cessation, weight control or generalized anxiety management processes.
services.outro_auriculoterapia: By using seeds or magnets, the treatment continues to work between sessions, allowing the person to actively participate by stimulating the indicated points in their daily life.
services.intro_fitoterapia_p1: Herbal medicine is a therapeutic discipline that uses medicinal plants and their extracts to treat ailments, restore organic balance and strengthen the body naturally.
services.intro_fitoterapia_p2: Within Traditional Chinese Medicine, herbal formulas are combined individually to address the root of the imbalance, taking into account each person's unique characteristics.
services.intro_fitoterapia_p3: Chinese herbal medicine is one of the most comprehensive branches of TCM and is often combined with acupuncture to enhance treatment results.
services.benefit_fitoterapia_1_desc: Unlike pharmaceuticals that usually palliate symptoms, herbal formulas seek to restore deep balance in the organism.
services.benefit_fitoterapia_2_desc: Medicinal plants act synergistically on various organs and body systems.
services.benefit_fitoterapia_3_desc: Many formulas include herbs with regulatory effects on the nervous system and emotional plane.
services.outro_fitoterapia: Each person receives a personalized formula made from medicinal plants, adapted to their energy diagnosis according to Traditional Chinese Medicine.
services.intro_ventosas_p1: Cupping therapy is an ancient technique used in Traditional Chinese Medicine that involves applying glass or silicone cups on the skin to create a vacuum that mobilizes stagnant blood, releases toxins and unblocks stagnant energy.
services.intro_ventosas_p2: By generating suction, the cups lift soft tissues, stimulating blood and lymphatic circulation, relieving muscle tension and promoting toxin elimination.
services.intro_ventosas_p3: It is a highly effective therapy for treating chronic contractures, trigger points, deep muscle pain, circulatory disorders and respiratory congestion processes such as bronchitis or colds.
services.benefit_ventosas_1_desc: Ideal for treating muscle knots, chronic contractures and neck or lower back stiffness.
services.benefit_ventosas_2_desc: Mobilizes stagnant blood and facilitates the elimination of metabolic waste from muscle tissue.
services.benefit_ventosas_3_desc: Stimulates the immune system response and decongests respiratory pathways.
services.outro_ventosas: It is not painful. Circular marks (painless bruises) may remain for a few days; this is an excellent biological sign that blood stasis has been mobilized.
services.intro_tuina_p1: Tuina massage is a technique of Traditional Chinese Medicine that combines kneading, pressure and stretching movements with acupressure and joint mobilization.
services.intro_tuina_p2: Its name means "grasp and push" and it works directly on the body's energy meridians, mobilizing Qi and blood, releasing tension and harmonizing energy flow.
services.intro_tuina_p3: It is especially indicated for contractures, sports injuries, joint pain, digestive problems and energy disorders.
services.benefit_tuina_1_desc: Effective for neck pain, lower back pain, sciatica and joint injuries.
services.benefit_tuina_2_desc: Through meridian stimulation, it can improve digestive, respiratory and circulatory function.
services.benefit_tuina_3_desc: Reduces stress and accumulated tension, promoting a state of calm and wellbeing.
services.outro_tuina: It is performed with comfortable clothing and does not require oils, making it very practical for midday sessions or before other activities.
services.intro_moxibustion_p1: Moxibustion is a technique of Traditional Chinese Medicine that involves the controlled burning of mugwort (moxa) on specific points of the body to warm, tonify and mobilize vital energy (Qi) and blood.
services.intro_moxibustion_p2: It is applied indirectly (with a moxa stick held near the point without touching the skin) or through a moxa box placed over an area of the body, generating a gentle, penetrating therapeutic heat.
services.intro_moxibustion_p3: Especially useful in cases of internal cold, energy deficiency, chronic pain worsened by cold, and conditions where energy does not reach the extremities.
services.benefit_moxibustion_1_desc: Strengthens vital energy, especially indicated for people with chronic fatigue, cold extremities or energy deficiency.
services.benefit_moxibustion_2_desc: Helps eliminate cold and dampness from the body, relieving joint and rheumatic pain.
services.benefit_moxibustion_3_desc: Stimulates blood and energy circulation in stagnant areas, promoting recovery from injuries.
services.outro_moxibustion: Moxibustion can be integrated with other techniques such as acupuncture to enhance its effects and is used both in consultation and as supervised self-care.
services.coachingIntro: A space designed for people at a vital turning point, seeking to overcome limiting fears and self-sabotage.
services.coachingPilar1Desc: I bring management and leadership experience to offer you structure and goals. We don't just talk about dreams; we draw up realistic action plans.
services.coachingPilar2Desc: The subconscious governs 95% of our behaviors. We remove emotional blocks and imprint new beliefs quickly.
services.coachingPilar3Desc: We understand that your ability to achieve depends on your level of energy coherence. We release old traumas blocking your strength.
services.coachingSesionDesc: Through subconscious communication (muscle testing) and brain integration techniques, we identify invisible obstacles and deactivate them in the same session. You leave with permission and the real ability to execute your changes.
services.sectionEnergeticasSubtext: Regain your balance, calm and clarity
services.energeticasIntroP1: Energy therapies are a space of deep support for people who wish to regain balance, calm, inner clarity and connection with themselves.
services.energeticasIntroP2: Sometimes discomfort is not only expressed in the body. It can also feel like emotional fatigue, blockage, anxiety, a sense of burden, difficulty moving forward, repetitive thoughts, sadness, lack of energy or inner disconnection.
services.energeticasIntroP3: In my practice I work with different energetic and integrative tools that allow me to accompany these processes in a personalized, respectful and conscious way. Each session is adapted to the person's moment, history, sensitivity and goal.
services.energeticasRecomendadasIntro: Energy therapies can help you if you feel:
services.energeticasChecklist3: Personal blocks or difficulty moving forward.
services.energeticasChecklist4: Stages of change, grief, separation or transformation.
services.energeticasChecklist5: Feeling of energetic burden or dense environments.
services.energeticasChecklist6: Need to close cycles from the past.
services.energeticasChecklist7: Lack of clarity, dispersion or inner disconnection.
services.energeticasChecklist8: Desire to harmonize your energy and regain balance.
services.energeticasDisclaimer: * This work does not replace medical, psychological or psychiatric treatment when necessary. It is offered as complementary support for your wellbeing, calm and personal process.
services.intro_pendulo_p1: The Hebrew Pendulum is an energy work tool that allows identifying and harmonizing imbalances in a person's energy field. It uses a system of symbols and frequencies that act at a subtle level to restore harmony.
services.intro_pendulo_p2: Through this technique, emotional blocks, energy burdens and alterations in the chakras can be detected, working to release and balance stagnant energy.
services.intro_pendulo_p3: My training in Hebrew Pendulum includes the Energy Reset Program, a tool especially valuable for highly sensitive people who wish to free themselves from burdens that do not belong to them.
services.benefit_pendulo_1_desc: Cleansing and reprogramming of limiting energy and emotional patterns.
services.benefit_pendulo_2_desc: Harmonization and alignment of the body's energy centers.
services.benefit_pendulo_3_desc: Protection and strengthening of the personal energy field against external influences.
services.outro_pendulo: Depending on the process, sessions may include Past Attachments, Light Missile or Space Energy Cleansing (in-person or distance).
services.intro_sanacion_p1: Quantum and Syntergic Healing is a set of techniques that work at the level of cellular memory, the energy field and consciousness, facilitating emotional release processes and reconnection with the person's essence.
services.intro_sanacion_p2: It is based on the principle that everything in the universe is energy and information. By working with frequencies, intention and conscious presence, stored patterns in the body that are no longer needed can be released.
services.benefit_sanacion_1_desc: Helps recover calm and clarity in periods of high pressure or demand.
services.benefit_sanacion_2_desc: Accompanies grief, anxiety, sadness or confusion processes.
services.benefit_sanacion_3_desc: Reconstitutes vital energy when physical and emotional fatigue has accumulated.
services.outro_sanacion: A non-invasive therapy perfect when a person feels they need a more compassionate, deep and conscious support to recover their wellbeing.
services.intro_biomagnetismo_p1: Quantum Biomagnetism is a therapy that uses medium and high intensity magnets to identify and balance alterations in the body's pH, restoring energy balance and promoting the body's recovery.
services.intro_biomagnetismo_p2: It is based on the principle that pathogenic microorganisms and organic dysfunctions develop in environments with altered pH. By applying specific biomagnetic pairs, the goal is to restore the body's natural pH.
services.benefit_biomagnetismo_1_desc: Helps restore the body's natural pH and harmonize its functioning.
services.benefit_biomagnetismo_2_desc: Can complement other energy or therapeutic treatments in a non-invasive way.
services.benefit_biomagnetismo_3_desc: Applied within a framework of conscious and responsible accompaniment, without replacing medical care.
services.outro_biomagnetismo: This therapy does not replace a medical or psychological diagnosis or treatment. It is offered as complementary support for your wellbeing.
services.sesionClosingP1: First we talk about the reason for your visit and the goal you wish to work on. Then I perform an energy assessment and apply the most suitable technique for your case.
services.sesionClosingP2: At the end, I explain in simple terms what was worked on and what you may notice in the following days. Every session is carried out with respect, care and confidentiality. My goal is to accompany you so you can feel calmer, clearer and more balanced in your process.
services.miFormaP1: I work from an integrative vision: body, mind, emotion and energy are part of the same story. That is why each person needs a unique accompaniment.
services.miFormaP2: I do not work with promises or magic solutions. I work with presence, listening, experience and tools that help organize, release and strengthen your energy consciously.
services.closingText: If you feel you are in a moment of change, blockage or inner fatigue, these therapies can help you reconnect and move forward with greater clarity.
